secret.label: Signing secret
secret.help: Fill in when the bot's security setting is "Signature"; leave blank for "Custom keyword" or when no security setting is enabled

secret.label: Signature verification secret
secret.help: Fill in when the bot has "Signature verification" enabled; otherwise leave blank

headers.label: Custom headers
headers.help: One KEY=VALUE per line, e.g. Authorization=Bearer xxx

body_template.label: Body template
body_template.help: Leave blank to use the built-in default template. Variables: '{{.Title}} {{.Batch}} {{.Count}} {{.HomeURL}} {{.SentAt}}', and under range .Items: .Name/.VulnClass/.Severity/.Summary/.Assets/.DetailURL/.StatusLabel. To insert a string, use '{{json .Xxx}}' instead of '{{.Xxx}}', otherwise quotes in the title will break the JSON.

base_url.label: API URL
base_url.help: Leave blank for the official endpoint; fill in when using a self-hosted Bot API reverse proxy

port.label: Port
port.help: 587 uses STARTTLS; for 465, turn on "Implicit TLS"

tls.label: Implicit TLS
tls.help: Turn on for port 465; keep off for 587 (STARTTLS is used automatically)
